newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-DST Systems up to outperform.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-DST Systems up to outperform.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co said on Monday it raised its rating on DST Systems Inc to outperform from outperform (speculative) after the company's first-quarter earnings came in ahead of analysts' estimates.

-- Gruntal said the $0.30 a share posted in the first quarter ended March 31 was higher than Gruntal's estimate of $0.25. The stock has already hit Gruntal's price target range twice and it appears to be an attractive buying point thanks to recent movements in its equity holdings, Gruntal said.
-- Gruntal said DST's double-digit increase in domestic revenues came from strength in mutual fund, shareholder and other output processing and subscriber management work.
-- DST develops software for the processing and record-keeping of mutual fund and other financial instruments.
-- Its shares were up 1/4 Monday at 25-1/2.
